Rotate into US tech via cross-listed proxies or ADRs, avoiding IDX tech until earnings season proves domestic monetization.

themes: Indonesia's nickel downstreaming policy continues to drive vertically integrated renewable and EV supply chain investments, benefiting TOBA's battery materials segment.

Domestic EV adoption is accelerating in Indonesia, with VKTR's commercial vehicle focus capitalizing on fleet electrification mandates and infrastructure buildout.
sectors.ai: Buy the pullback in Indonesian renewables, led by TOBA and VKTR, as the sector's +0.97% local outperformance signals domestic policy tailwinds. US solar names (SEDG, ENPH, FSLR) confirm global demand strength. Accumulate TOBA for nickel-integrated EV battery exposure and VKTR for commercial EV adoption, targeting 15% upside over 3 months.

Rupiah stability and falling BI rates are lowering financing costs for consumer companies, enabling capex for capacity expansion and digital channel penetration.
sectors.ai: Rotate into mid-cap consumer names with proven earnings delivery (ENZO, PADA, MBTO) while trimming large-cap staples that lag the IDX momentum. The WATCH signal favors selective accumulation on pullbacks, not broad beta. Prioritize companies with domestic volume growth and margin expansion from input-cost relief; exit names with weak cash conversion or stretched valuations post-rally.

Add on pullbacks to +1.43% aggregate; overweight Indonesian port/warehouse operators with export exposure, trim pure-play US brokers after +3% run.
